convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load external custom indicator 'MALR' with 5 parameters. Averaging and position overturn logic add complexity. Custom indicator buffers 3 and 4 drive signals, requiring manual recreation of the MALR indicator logic in Python.

derived_values.name: high_extr from MALR buffer 3 (previous 2 bars)
derived_values.used_by: Entry signal: high_extr[0]<=close[0] && high_extr[1]>=close[1] for sell

derived_values.name: low_extr from MALR buffer 4 (previous 2 bars)
derived_values.used_by: Entry signal: low_extr[0]>=close[0] && low_extr[1]<=close[1] for buy

derived_values.name: propn - floating loss in points for current position
derived_values.formula: prev_open - ASK (for buy) or BID - prev_open (for sell)
derived_values.used_by: Averaging entry gate: propn >= loss_forAveraging * point

derived_values.name: prev_avlot - lot size of last non-overturn deal
_nLt for deposit fraction sizing
derived_values.used_by: Position sizing when use_increase=true and no position open

long.left: low_extr crossover close on bars [1] and [2]

short.left: high_extr crossunder close on bars [1] and [2]

other_exits: Position overturn: on opposite MALR signal, close existing position and open reverse with multiplied lot (vol * koff_multiplication)
Averaging: when floating loss >= loss_forAveraging pips, open additional same-direction position with previous non-overturn lot size

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Fixed Lot=0.1 by default; if use_increase=true and no position open, lot = Lot * Equity / Max_drawdown; if overturn (mode=3), lot = previous_lot * koff_multiplication; if averaging (mode=2), lot = prev_avlot from deal history; clamped to min_lot/max_lot

custom_logic_notes: MALR custom indicator provides high_extr (buffer 3) and low_extr (buffer 4) channel levels. Entry signal is a crossover of these channel levels with close price on completed bars [1] and [2] (shifted by 1). Averaging logic opens additional same-direction positions when floating loss exceeds loss_forAveraging points. Position overturn closes and reverses with multiplied lot on opposite signal. SL/TP modification retried up to N_modify_sltp times with 1s delay. The SL/TP values (2550/2578) are in points not pips, suggesting 5-digit broker targeting ~255/258 pip equivalents.
external_dependencies: MALR custom indicator (iCustom call with 5 params: MAPeriod, MAShift, AppliedPrice, ChannelReversal, ChannelBreakout)
python_conversion_notes: Must reverse-engineer or obtain the MALR custom indicator source to replicate buffers 3 (high_extr) and 4 (low_extr). Entry logic uses previous 2 completed bars (index 1 and 2), not current bar. Averaging and overturn modes create complex position management that needs careful state tracking of prev_open and prev_avlot. SL/TP are in points (multiply by point_value); for 5-digit brokers, 2550 points = 255 pips. The trailing stop activates only after profit threshold is reached (Activate_by_profit). Deposit-fraction sizing formula: lot = base_lot * equity / max_drawdown.
